# Synthesise Rather Than Redact

**Decision.** Do not publish the sensitive corpus with identifying values blacked out. Publish a
**wholly invented dataset** whose every value is generated, and whose relational structure and
statistical patterns are carried over from the real matter unchanged.

**Date.** 2026-07-11, [[labour-fraud-analysis]]. This is the repository's central methodological
choice — everything in `src/` exists to execute it.

## Why

Two requirements pull in opposite directions, and the repo states both as hard rules:

> "**No real value may ever reach version control** — not in the data, not in the docs, and *not in
> the code that does the anonymizing.*"
> — labour-fraud-analysis-a-forensic-data-investigation/docs/methodology.md, 2026-07-11

> "**The result must stay analytically honest** — same relational structure, same statistical
> patterns (bulk permits, entity succession, shared-contact control, financial anomalies), so the
> analysis demonstrates real skill rather than toy data."
> — labour-fraud-analysis-a-forensic-data-investigation/docs/methodology.md, 2026-07-11

Redaction satisfies the first and destroys the second. A blacked-out contact field cannot show that
sixty-six workers share two inboxes; a blacked-out permit number cannot show that a day's batch runs
contiguous. The signals in this case **are** the identifiers' relationships to each other, so
removing the identifiers removes the case. Synthesis is what reconciles the two constraints:

> "Reconciling those is the whole trick: replace every *value*, preserve every *relationship*."
> — labour-fraud-analysis-a-forensic-data-investigation/docs/methodology.md, 2026-07-11

That reconciliation is [[structure-preserving-anonymisation]], made consistent across tables and
free text by [[deterministic-seeded-substitution]] and kept parseable by
[[format-preserving-invalid-identifiers]]. The signals that survive are the subject of
[[shared-identifier-clustering]] and [[convergent-evidence]].

## Alternatives rejected

| Option | Why not |
|---|---|
| **Publish the redacted source** | the source *was already* a redacted real-world matter; redaction leaves the analytical patterns unreadable, which is the requirement above |
| **Generate toy data from scratch** | named explicitly as the failure mode — an analysis over invented-from-nothing data "demonstrates real skill" of nobody |
| **Publish nothing; describe the work in prose** | leaves no artefact to run, review, or verify; the pipeline and its gate *are* the deliverable |
| **Aggregate/statistical release only** | not named in the repo. **TODO:** unrecorded whether it was considered |

## What makes it defensible rather than a claim

Synthesis on its own is an assertion. What makes it checkable is that a separate program tries to
break it: the [[disclosure-gate]] rebuilds a blocklist from the private source at run time and greps
the entire published tree for survivors, backed by a stem guard, a regex sweep and structural
integrity checks. The scrubbing code is careful not to become the leak it prevents:

> "This script may reference real strings *at run time* because it reads them from the private
> source; it contains none in its own text."
> — labour-fraud-analysis-a-forensic-data-investigation/src/anonymize.py, 2026-07-11

## The costs, stated

- **The gate's strongest checks cannot run in public CI.** The leak scan and stem guard need the
  private corpus, which no public runner has. The README's "test-verified in CI" claim is therefore
  stronger than what a clean runner enforces. `confidence: high`, interview-confirmed 2026-07-28 —
  see [[github-actions]] and [[generated-docs-checked-by-ci-diff]].
- **Synthesis is not total.** Column names retaining source-jurisdiction registers, an allow-list
  naming a country and its adjective, a national-ID regex, a country-code phone pattern and a locale
  string in the viewer all survive in committed code. None is a person-like value; together they
  narrow the source jurisdiction and the worker-origin corridor, which sits against the
  methodology's claim that no origin-signalling scrap survives.
- **Every specific case number is prose.** The narrative's figures are typed into `docs/`, and only
  some are recomputed by the notebook or dashboard. See [[chain-of-custody]] for what *is* anchored.
- **Verification is one-machine.** Re-running the pipeline end-to-end needs the private source, so
  nobody else can confirm the published data is what the committed seed and code would produce —
  [[reproducible-analysis]].

## Publish stance

Every wiki page for this repository was `publish: false`, per the interview. **That blanket was
lifted on 2026-07-30**; what it was standing in for was not.

The synthesis decision does **not** by itself establish a right to republish the derived form: the
underlying matter is described in the repo as live and under review, and no clearance from the
corpus holder is evidenced anywhere. What is public now is the method — seeded substitution, the
disclosure gate, the verification step — and not the matter, the corpus, or the dataset the method
produced. See the open gaps on [[labour-fraud-analysis]].
